name: @w6w-apps/moonclerk
description: Read MoonClerk payment forms, customers (plans) and payments through the MoonClerk read-only API.

w6w.longDescription:
MoonClerk builds payment forms on top of Stripe: one-time checkouts, subscriptions and installment plans, with a hosted page where a customer manages their own plan. This app connects a workflow to MoonClerk's read-only REST API with an API key.

A workflow can list and read payment forms with their volume and checkout counts; list and read customers (what the MoonClerk dashboard calls plans) with their subscription, plan amount, next payment date, discount, custom-field answers and self-service management URL, filtered by form, checkout date, next-payment date or subscription status; and list and read payments, filtered by form, customer, charge date or status, with the Stripe fee, refunded amount and Stripe references. Nothing can be created, changed or cancelled: MoonClerk's API is read-only.

MoonClerk answers a bad key with a plain-text HTTP 401 `HTTP Token: Access denied.`; this app reads that body. Health checks verify the key and whether the API answers.
